name: theme-warm
summary: Content-first warm theme for Web and Admin: paper neutrals, ink text, terracotta accent, soft radius.
description: Restyles the Web application and the Admin Console through design tokens only: warm paper-like neutrals, ink-like text, a terracotta brand accent, and a softer radius suited to long-form reading such as documentation, knowledge bases, and content sites. Light and dark mode are both covered and every checked readable pair meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. No component changes; remove the plugin to return to the default tokens.
use_when: the product is content-first: documentation, a knowledge base, a blog, or a community
the builder asks for a warm, friendly, soft, or editorial look
long text should be comfortable to read in light and dark mode
